hook: Your post office was printed by a robot.
title: India's Post Office Printed by a Robot
description:
The Cambridge Layout post office in Bengaluru was built using a 3D-printing robot. Look closely at the footage and you can see the printed layers in the walls. It is a working post office, not a model.

#Shorts #3DPrinting #Bengaluru
comment_prompt: Would you trust it? Yes or no
